summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Concourse Capital Focused Equity ETF (CCFE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund targets investments towards undervalued securities with growth characteristics, located in North America. The fund is actively managed, using fundamental analysis to select and weight holdings CCFE was launched on Jun 12, 2025 and is issued by Concourse.

holdings.infoBox: CCFE is an equity ETF with a total of 29 individual holdings. The top holdings are First American Government Obligs X stock at 7.54%, Cooper-Standard Holdings at 7.22%, Advance Auto Parts at 5.95%, Columbus McKinnon at 5.67%, and GXO Logistics at 4.48%.
